description: Land Acquisition - Kollupitiya, Thimbirigasyaya D/S Division, Colombo District and Nadukkadu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders for taking immediate possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleka), this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land acquisition. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects."
